description:
Vortex is the new, modern mod manager from Nexus Mods.

Vortex is the new, modern mod manager from Nexus Mods.
It is designed to make modding your game as simple as possible for new users, while still providing enough control for more experienced veterans of the modding scene.
Led by Tannin, the creator of Mod Organizer, Vortex takes the lessons learnt during the development of MO and Nexus Mod Manager to provide the most powerful and intuitive modding experience available.
As the November chill sets in and the days get noticeably shorter, there is absolutely no better excuse to stay indoors, wrap up warm, and get lost in a freshly modded game. We’ve packed Vortex 2.11 with a brilliant batch of visual tweaks and some crucial under-the-hood fixes to keep your load orders running flawlessly.
Here is a quick look at what’s new!
✨ Sleeker Settings & Interface Polish
Finding your settings shouldn't be a maze. We've added a handy "Vortex settings" button directly inside your Game settings, and tucked a global Settings link right into your profile menu. Across the app, you'll notice shiny new icons , and several menus have been given a gorgeous redesign, including the 'What's New' screen, which will now beautifully display images and videos from our release notes.
🛠️ Smoother Installs & Crucial Fixes
- Epic Games Detection: Vortex is once again properly detecting games installed via newer versions of the Epic Games Launcher.
- Smarter Script Extenders: Script extenders downloaded directly from Nexus Mods will now automatically deploy themselves after installing.
- No More Overlap Data Loss: If two completely different mods (like an ENB and an Engine Injector) both ship the exact same file (like d3d9.dll), Vortex will now keep the original game file safe instead of causing data loss.
- Collections: Massive collections no longer stall at the very end while updating their rules, and collection installs are more reliable generally. Vortex won’t fail mods that were still progressing, install the same mod twice, install optional mods you declined, or throw “File already downloaded” when the archive is already on disk.
- Health Check & Recovery: A damaged deployment file now comes with clear, plain-English instructions on how to recover. For free users, the Health Check's install option now properly routes you to the mod's file page so you can choose your download speed.
- A More Resilient Mods Page: The Mods page will no longer fail to load just because a mod or download happens to be missing its name.
- Linux Love: For our community playing on Linux, the Dashboard will now correctly display your free disk space hints!
🐛 Spot a Bug? Let Us Know!
Spotted a wild bug that managed to escape?
Report it on GitHub! Simply attach a support bundle so the team can see what went wrong. To make one, click your profile picture in the top right to open the user menu, then go to Help > Create support bundle. It packs your logs and state into a single archive ready to attach.
For questions, feedback, or just a chat, join the Vortex channel on the official Nexus Mods Discord
And if you want the raw, unedited list of every single technical tweak, check out the full full, unfiltered changelog.
